In between, we need to switch source\n         * textures and target framebuffers between the passed in external framebuffer and the internal\n         * framebuffer, because we cannot read and write to the same framebuffer in one render pass.\n         * If the number of effects is even, we start by writing the internal framebuffer, else we\n         * start with the external framebuffer.\n         */\n        Framebuffer internalFB = mFramebuffer;\n        Framebuffer externalFB = target;\n        boolean useInternalFB = mEffects.size() % 2 == 0; // keeps track of which framebuffer to use as setRotateEulerM(float[] rm, int rmOffset, float x, float y, float z) {\n            x = x * 0.01745329f;\n            y = y * 0.01745329f;\n            z = z * 0.01745329f;\n            float sx = /**\r\n     * @param name String der �berpr�ft werden soll\r\n     * @return Fehler meldung, falls alles okay dann null\r\n     */\r\n    public static String checkName(String name)\r\n    {\r\n        // Zu lang?\r\n        if(name.length() > 32) {\r\n            return \"Name too long\";\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        if(name.length() == 0) {\r\n            return \"Empty name!\";\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        // Sonderzeichen\r\n        int spaces = 0;\r\n\r\n        for(int i = 0; i < name.length(); i++) {\r\n            char c = name.charAt(i);\r\n\r\n            // Erlaubte Zeichen\r\n            if(c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') {\r\n                continue;\r\n            }\r\n            if(c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') {\r\n                continue;\r\n            }\r\n            if(c >= '0' && c <= '9') {\r\n                continue;\r\n            }\r\n            if(c == ' ') {\r\n                spaces++;\r\n                continue;\r\n            }\r\n\r\n            return \"Character \" + c + \" not permitted!\";\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        if(spaces == name.length()) {\r\n            return \"Only spaces are not allowed!\";\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        return null;\r\n     self.column_margin = kwargs.get('column_margin',\n                                        default_margin * 2 / (5.0 + self.columns))\n\n\n        # calculate margins in mm for browsers\n        self.margins = []\n        for m, clip in ((self.top_margin, 0),\n                        (self.side_margin, 0.5 * self.gutter),\n                        (self.bottom_margin, 0),\n                        (self.side_margin, 0.5 * self.gutter),\n                        ):\n            self.margins.append((m + clip) * POINT_2_MM)\n\n        if 'PDFGEN' in config.DEBUG_MODES:\n            log(\"making )\n\n            column_pdf = pdf[:-4] + '-single-column.pdf'\n            columnmaker.make_raw_pdf(html, column_pdf, outline=outline,\n                                     outline_file=outline_file,
